scenario_contract: For every scenario: START STATE -> USER ACTION -> EXPECTED DOM/STATE -> EXPECTED VISUAL RESULT. Future extraction/candidate replay fails parity if a P0 scenario loses the documented behavior without an explicit higher-authority supersession.

golden_parity_laws.law: At accepted desktop 1440×1000, preserve or improve the usable three-pane Library composition, document readability, context reachability, and bottom-shelf access; pixel identity is not required when a current Owner correction deliberately supersedes presentation.
Read mode is non-editable; Edit mode exposes real content editing. A typed change must commit to working state/history and drive truthful save status.
Single block selection drives block context; multi-select is stateful, count-aware, command-aware, and Escape-unwindable.
Insertion targets exact structural gaps; deletion respects subtree risk; reorder and drag/drop operate on canonical block identity/nesting and are undoable.
Clipboard claims must match browser clipboard evidence. Cut is atomic: clipboard success first, deletion second; clipboard failure must never delete content.
Rich paste crosses a sanitizer trust boundary: unsupported/dangerous markup is removed, safe portable markup is retained, and the result participates in history.
Keyboard users get equivalent command access: Ctrl+K, / search, F6 region cycling, Shift+F10 block menu, modal focus containment, deterministic Escape and focus return.
Pane collapse changes both layout and accessibility exposure; separators support keyboard resize; Focus Mode round-trips prior presentation state.
Bidi is block-aware: Arabic-first auto resolves RTL, English-first auto resolves LTR, technical code stays LTR, and explicit direction override is undoable.
Structure tree, center editor, right context and bottom deep-work shelf remain synchronized to one active knowledge/document state.
Empty and failure states are explicit and recoverable. Hidden diagnostic StateLab simulations are not Golden product UX and cannot be used as production error/loading proof.

Responsive medium/narrow behavior is supplemental resilience. The accepted desktop viewport is the primary parity gate; constrained widths must avoid destructive center squeeze and expose support panes as reachable overlays.

scenarios.name_ar: الإقلاع والتخطيط الذهبي عند 1440×1000
scenarios.start_state: Donor exact bytes; fresh browser context; 1440×1000.
user_actions: Load exact self-contained donor in Chromium.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: body: mode=read, responsiveBand=wide, left=open, right=open; 15 rendered blocks; no editables; no page/console errors.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Three-pane dark Library workspace with global + Library navigation, banner, structured document, context pane and bottom shelf rail; no overlap/clipping at accepted viewport.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject extraction if accepted desktop shell loses usable three-pane composition, initial 15-block document, or introduces runtime errors.

scenarios.name_ar: التحرير الفعلي + تحديد الكتلة + مزامنة Context
scenarios.start_state: Read mode with original p1.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: p1 selected; Context scope switches to block and names blk-d05-p1; committed text persists in DOM; Undo becomes available; save state becomes dirty/autosaving.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Selected block and context are visibly coupled; typed content appears in place without replacing block identity.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if content can type but does not commit to history/context, or context pane does not follow selected block.

scenarios.name_ar: Undo / Redo كمعاملة تحرير قابلة للاسترداد
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode, unchanged p1.
user_actions: Append one edit transaction and blur.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Undo restores exact prior block content; Redo restores committed edit; toolbar availability tracks history truth.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Content visibly rolls backward/forward without losing block structure.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if committed edit is not one reversible history transaction or redo cannot restore it.

scenarios.name_ar: Single / Multi-select + Escape unwind
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; no multi-selection.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Single selection drives block context. Ctrl-click creates two-ID multi-selection and visible 2-block toolbar. Escape clears multi-selection first.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Two rows show selected styling; contextual multi-block command rail appears then disappears on Escape.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if multi-selection is cosmetic only, count is wrong, or Escape cannot deterministically unwind selection.

scenarios.name_ar: الإدراج بين الكتل من Gap Palette
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode, 15 blocks, first structural gap before h2.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Palette opens; exactly one new paragraph is inserted at targeted structural index, receives a new ID, focuses for edit, and is undoable.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: A real blank paragraph appears at the requested boundary; palette closes; document reflows without layout breakage.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if insertion is appended to wrong location, loses structural identity, or cannot be undone.

scenarios.name_ar: Smart structural delete + subtree confirmation
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; toggle t1 owns two descendants.
user_actions: Verify confirmation appears for structural risk.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Smart policy detects subtree risk; confirmation is required; exactly t1 + its two descendants are removed as one transaction; undo restores all.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Confirmation explicitly warns before branch loss; after confirmation subtree disappears cleanly; undo restores it.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if parent deletion can silently orphan/drop descendants without smart confirmation, or if subtree deletion is not atomic/undoable.

scenarios.name_ar: إعادة الترتيب البنيوي من قائمة الكتلة
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; p1 precedes p-auto-ltr at root.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: p1 changes structural index by exactly one, sibling identity preserved, undo restores original order.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Rows exchange positions without copy/re-render identity loss or accidental nesting.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if reorder is visual-only, changes IDs, changes nesting unintentionally, or lacks undo parity.

scenarios.name_ar: Drag & Drop مع feedback بنيوي حقيقي
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; p1 before p-auto-ltr.
user_actions: Hover a structural drop boundary after p-auto-ltr.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Source exposes dragging state after threshold; a structural target/preview appears; drop moves subtree to intended legal gap.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Source row enters drag styling and insertion/drop feedback becomes visible before commit; final row order changes only on drop.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if drag has no pre-drop target feedback, commits before pointer-up, or produces a different structural location.

scenarios.name_ar: Copy من تحديد نصي مع Clipboard MIME truth
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; p1 focused.
user_actions: Create a real DOM text selection inside p1.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Copy event carries exact selected text/plain and formatted text/html when formatted clipboard preference is active; UI selection context remains truthful.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Text remains selected; copy does not mutate content; selection toolbar/context may expose selection actions.
limitations: Range creation is scripted only to make a deterministic RTL substring; the copy command itself is a real Chromium keyboard event and donor copy handler.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if formatted-copy claims success without browser clipboard event data, or copied plain text differs from selection.

scenarios.name_ar: Atomic Cut: الحافظة أولًا ثم الحذف
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; p1 exists.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Cut writes clipboard first; only after successful clipboard write is p1 deleted; success feedback names the successful mode.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: p1 disappears only after positive clipboard result; user receives explicit truthful cut feedback.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if Cut can delete before clipboard success or UI claims success when clipboard write failed.

scenarios.name_ar: Safe Rich Paste مع allowlist sanitizer
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; caret at end of p1; rich paste enabled.
user_actions: Dispatch a browser ClipboardEvent containing safe bold text plus img/onerror, script, and javascript: URL.
Let donor paste handler sanitize and commit.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Supported portable inline markup inserts; script/img/event handlers/javascript URLs do not survive or execute; paste is committed to history.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Safe text appears; malicious/unsupported visual content does not render; success feedback remains bounded to sanitized content.
limitations: ClipboardEvent data is synthetic because the automation environment cannot seed the OS clipboard with arbitrary HTML; sanitization, DOM insertion, commit, and history run in real Chromium through the donor handler.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if rich paste can execute scripts/event handlers, preserve javascript URLs, or bypass history commit.

scenarios.name_ar: Command Palette: Ctrl+K + focus trap + Escape
scenarios.start_state: Read mode; no modal open.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Command backdrop opens and receives focus; Tab remains trapped inside modal; Escape closes top overlay and returns to workspace.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Centered command UI overlays workspace with unambiguous focus; background is visually de-emphasized.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if Ctrl+K is dead, focus escapes behind modal, or Escape cannot close the top overlay.

scenarios.name_ar: اختصارات القراءة: / للبحث و F6 للتنقل بين المناطق
scenarios.start_state: Read mode, no overlay.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: / focuses kuSearch in read mode; F6 cycles across primary workspace regions rather than trapping in one pane.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Keyboard user can visibly jump into search and cycle major panes without mouse.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if read-mode / shortcut steals text editing incorrectly, or F6 cannot traverse major regions.

scenarios.name_ar: Pane collapse + keyboard separator resize
scenarios.start_state: Wide viewport; left and right open; left separator ~304px.
user_actions: Collapse left pane via local toggle.
Focus separator and press ArrowRight twice.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Collapse removes pane from active layout/accessibility flow; center expands. Separator Arrow keys adjust aria-valuenow and pane width in bounded steps.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Pane disappears/reappears without overlap; width change is visible and operable without pointer drag.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if collapse only hides visually but leaves focusable content, or separator lacks keyboard resizing.

scenarios.name_ar: Focus Mode يحفظ presentation ثم يعيدها
scenarios.start_state: Wide desktop with support panes open and banner expanded.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Focus mode hides support panes and banner and closes bottom work area while preserving previous presentation; exit restores previous pane/banner state.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Center document becomes distraction-reduced; restoration returns to the same workspace composition rather than defaults.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if Focus Mode destroys prior pane state or requires manual reconstruction after exit.

scenarios.name_ar: RTL/LTR: auto first-strong + explicit per-block direction
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode with Arabic-first auto paragraph, English-first auto paragraph, technical code block.
user_actions: Open Arabic p1 block menu > تنسيق > LTR.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Arabic-first auto resolves RTL; English-first auto resolves LTR; code remains LTR. Explicit LTR overrides p1 and is undoable back to auto/RTL.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Mixed Arabic/English stays readable; technical tokens/code preserve LTR; explicit block direction changes alignment/flow predictably.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if auto direction collapses all blocks to page RTL, code is mirrored, or explicit direction is not persisted/undoable.

scenarios.name_ar: مزامنة Structure / Context / Bottom Shelf
scenarios.start_state: Active KU in tree; edit mode.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Tree retains current KU; Context inspector updates to exact selected block ID; bottom shelf opens without losing selection and presents history/compare/recovery workspace.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Left navigation, center selection, right context and bottom deep-work surface remain coherent rather than independent mock panels.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if selecting a center block leaves stale right context or opening bottom shelf disrupts active KU/selection.

scenarios.name_ar: Empty state لبحث البنية + استعادة السياق
scenarios.start_state: Read mode with populated knowledge tree.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: No-match state is explicit rather than blank failure; clearing restores tree and current KU indication.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: User sees a bounded empty-state message and a recovery path; normal tree returns after clear.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if search yields unexplained blank pane or clearing loses current knowledge-unit context.

scenarios.name_ar: Menus / Preferences / Shortcuts overlays + focus containment
scenarios.start_state: Read mode; no overlay.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Menus expose workspace, bidi, clipboard, code, save/recovery, appearance, deletion and accessibility controls. Modal shortcuts keep focus contained and Escape closes.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Overlays appear above workspace with clear grouping and keyboard-dismiss behavior; focus does not leak behind the active modal.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if high-value preferences disappear, modal focus leaks, or nested overlays cannot be dismissed predictably.

scenarios.name_ar: Responsive bands + overlay panes
scenarios.start_state: Start at accepted desktop 1440×1000 wide.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Wide/medium/narrow bands update. Support panes collapse when center width would be harmed and reveal as overlay with scrim in constrained widths; returning wide restores wide composition logic.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Center content remains usable instead of being squeezed below its minimum; support panes become temporary overlays on constrained widths.
limitations: 1440×1000 is the accepted desktop parity viewport; 1100/720 checks are supplementary resilience evidence, not authority to redesign the desktop shell.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject desktop extraction if it breaks 1440×1000; constrained widths must at minimum avoid unusable center squeeze/overlap.

scenarios.name_ar: حدود Loading/Error/Recovery: لا نرقّي StateLab المخفي إلى Golden
scenarios.start_state: Accepted donor normal runtime.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Non-production StateLab remains CSS-hidden and must not be treated as accepted loading/error UX. Only exposed recovery/history behavior is Golden evidence; backend loading/error semantics require future admitted product evidence.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: No fake diagnostic lab appears to user. Recovery workspace is exposed through the bottom shelf, while hidden simulation controls stay absent.
limitations: The donor contains hidden diagnostic state simulation. R3 explicitly excludes it from Golden product parity rather than claiming simulated conflict/loading as accepted UX.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject any audit that treats hidden StateLab simulations as proof of production loading/error parity.

scenarios.name_ar: Block-handle keyboard menu + menu search + focus return
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; p1 block handle focused by keyboard.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Shift+F10 opens same block command surface as pointer. / focuses menu search. Escape closes and restores focus to invoking handle.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: Keyboard receives the same structural commands as mouse, with visible focus styling and deterministic focus return.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if structural block commands are pointer-only or closing menu drops keyboard focus unpredictably.

scenarios.name_ar: Clipboard failure: Cut يفشل بدون فقد بيانات
scenarios.start_state: Edit mode; p1 exists; clipboard transports intentionally unavailable.
user_actions: Open p1 > نسخ ومشاركة > قص العنصر.
scenarios.expected_dom_state: Cut failure is caught; p1 remains in document; block count is unchanged; UI reports that deletion did not happen because clipboard write failed.
scenarios.expected_visual_result: User sees an explicit error toast and content remains visibly intact.
limitations: Clipboard unavailability is deliberately fault-injected in Chromium to exercise the real donor failure branch; Foundation/donor source is not modified.
scenarios.rejection_gate: Reject if a failed clipboard write can still remove content, or if error feedback falsely claims a successful cut.

exclusions_and_limits: No Foundation or Writer A candidate source was mutated.
No old GitHub/Production authority was used.
The hidden StateLab is explicitly excluded from Golden production loading/error semantics.
OS-level clipboard seeding for arbitrary HTML was unavailable; G11 uses a synthetic ClipboardEvent only as input transport, while sanitizer, DOM insertion, commit and undo execute in real Chromium.
G09 creates a deterministic RTL DOM Range programmatically; the Ctrl+C event and donor clipboard handler are real browser execution.
G23 deliberately removes browser clipboard capabilities to exercise the donor’s real failure branch; donor source is not changed.
R3 establishes the Golden oracle; it does not self-accept the Foundation or Writer A candidate.
